nodes.description: Mapping of token balances per address; mutated by _transfer, _approveCheck, _mint and _burn.
Whitelist mapping used by burnTokenCheck to bypass transfer restrictions.
Blacklist mapping used by burnTokenCheck to block transfers.
Threshold amount set by the owner and compared against transfer amount inside burnTokenCheck.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances, written by _approve.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Owner address used as the authority gate in multiTransfer, _mint, increaseAllowance, decreaseAllowance and addApprove.
Secondary privileged address settable by the owner and consulted by burnTokenCheck.
Hardcoded Uniswap router address accepted as a transfer recipient in burnTokenCheck.
Public ERC20 transfer that routes through _approveCheck.
Owner-only batch transfer that also whitelists receivers and grants router allowance.
Public transferFrom that debits allowance and routes through _approveCheck.
Owner-only function that whitelists an array of addresses.
Owner-only function that reassigns _safeOwner from a caller-supplied address.
Owner-only function that blacklists an array of addresses.
Internal transfer that debits sender and credits recipient balances.
Public mint function gated only by msg.sender == _owner that inflates supply.
Internal burn reducing balance and total supply.
Internal allowance setter writing _allowances.
Internal balance-moving function guarded by the burnTokenCheck modifier.
Modifier implementing owner/whitelist/blacklist/sell-amount gating logic around transfers.
Deploys token metadata, sets _owner/_safeOwner and mints the initial supply.
Address library helper performing a raw value transfer call.
Address library private helper performing a raw call with value and data.

Low-level call{value:weiValue}(data) forwarding all gas to an arbitrary target.

edges.reason: _msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
transfer uses msg.sender as the sender identity for the allowance check.
multiTransfer requires msg.sender == _owner to execute batch privileged transfers.
increaseAllowance gates whitelisting on msg.sender == _owner.
decreaseAllowance gates _safeOwner reassignment on msg.sender == _owner.
addApprove gates blacklisting on msg.sender == _owner.
_mint is public and only restricts msg.sender == _owner.
transferFrom consumes _msgSender as the spender for allowance debiting.
multiTransfer compares the caller against the stored _owner address.
increaseAllowance compares the caller against _owner.
decreaseAllowance compares the caller against _owner.
addApprove compares the caller against _owner.
_mint compares the caller against _owner before minting.
burnTokenCheck branches on whether _owner equals _safeOwner and whether sender is _owner.
burnTokenCheck uses _safeOwner to authorize or redirect transfers.
burnTokenCheck consults _whiteAddress to bypass restriction logic.
burnTokenCheck consults _blackAddress to block or require special recipients.
burnTokenCheck compares the transfer amount against the stored _sellAmount threshold.
burnTokenCheck compares the recipient against the hardcoded _unirouter address.
multiTransfer invokes transfer for each receiver.
multiTransfer invokes _approve to grant the router allowance.
multiTransfer writes true into _whiteAddress for early receivers.
transfer delegates balance movement to _approveCheck.
transferFrom delegates balance movement to _approveCheck.
transferFrom decreases the spender allowance via _approve.
_approveCheck execution is gated by the burnTokenCheck modifier logic.
_approveCheck debits and credits _balances.
_transfer debits and credits _balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint credits _balances of the owner.
_burn debits _balances of the burned account.
_burn reduces _totalSupply.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
constructor assigns the deployer-supplied owner to _owner.
constructor assigns the deployer-supplied owner to _safeOwner.
constructor calls the public _mint to create the initial supply.
addApprove sets _blackAddress entries to true.
addApprove clears _whiteAddress entries.
increaseAllowance sets _whiteAddress entries to true.
increaseAllowance clears _blackAddress entries.
decreaseAllowance overwrites _safeOwner with an arbitrary address.
sendValue performs a low-level value call forwarding all gas to the recipient.
_functionCallWithValue performs a low-level call forwarding all gas to the target.
_mint is publicly reachable and can inflate supply through the owner gate.
A malicious recipient contract can reenter balance-moving logic during the raw value call.
A malicious target contract can reenter _approveCheck during the raw call with value.
receivers array is consumed by the multiTransfer loop.
amounts array is consumed by the multiTransfer loop.
sender parameter flows into _approveCheck balance debits.
recipient parameter flows into _approveCheck balance credits.
amount parameter flows into _approveCheck arithmetic.
safeOwner parameter is written into the _safeOwner state variable.
loop index i drives the multiTransfer iteration.

normalization_plan.reason: receivers is a parameter only used inside multiTransfer.
amounts is a parameter only used inside multiTransfer.
sender parameter only feeds _approveCheck balance mutations.
recipient parameter only feeds _approveCheck balance mutations.
safeOwner parameter only sets the _safeOwner state variable in decreaseAllowance.
loop index i is a local variable confined to multiTransfer.
